name: freshworks-dev-tools
description: Freshworks Platform 3.0 developer skills: FDK and Node lifecycle, app development, MCP server integrations, automated app review, and marketplace publishing.

plugins.name: fw-setup
plugins.description: Install, upgrade, downgrade, and uninstall the Freshworks Development Kit (FDK) with Node.js via nvm (macOS, Windows, Linux).

interface.shortDescription: FDK and Node.js toolchain install and lifecycle via nvm.
interface.longDescription: Automates FDK 10.x on Node 24 (recommended for publishing), optional FDK 9.x on Node 18 for legacy work, shell troubleshooting, and workspace nvm/.nvmrc alignment. Slash commands: /fw-setup-install, /fw-setup-upgrade, /fw-setup-downgrade, /fw-setup-uninstall, /fw-setup-status, /fw-setup-troubleshoot, /fw-setup-use.

plugins.name: fw-app-dev
plugins.description: Expert-level skill for building, debugging, reviewing, and migrating Freshworks Platform 3.0 custom apps.

interface.shortDescription: Platform 3.0 apps: manifest, requests, OAuth, serverless, and UI.
interface.longDescription: Enforces Platform 3.0 patterns (modules, request templates, engines), Crayons UI, validation workflows, and slash commands /fdk-fix, /fdk-migrate, /fdk-refactor. For structured pre-submission review, use fw-review skill. Does not install FDK or Node — pair with fw-setup.

plugins.name: fw-build-your-mcp-server
plugins.description: Build your own MCP server on Platform 3.0: actions.json, SMI, request templates, schemas, validation, and integration workflows.

interface.shortDescription: actions.json, SMI handlers, request templates, and API integrations.
interface.longDescription: Flat request parameters, nested response mapping in server.js, iparams/OAuth, test data guardrails, debugging broken endpoints, and scoping checklists. Complements fw-app-dev for full custom apps.

plugins.name: fw-review
plugins.description: Automated Freshworks custom app review: iparams, frontend, deterministic script checks, security, and structured report output.

interface.shortDescription: Rules + scripts for structured custom app audits.
interface.longDescription: Evaluates manifest, iparams, frontend, and SC-* script-backed checks with a fixed report format. Pair with fw-setup for FDK and fw-app-dev to remediate findings.

plugins.name: fw-publish
plugins.description: Publish Platform 3.0 custom apps to the Freshworks Marketplace using MCP tools (validate, pack, app-upload, submit/update).

interface.longDescription: Guides agents through auth preflight, fdk validate/pack, app-upload, and marketplace submit/update via MCP. MCP config: .mcp.json at repository root. API key from https://developers.freshworks.com/developer/ - API key for Freddy AI Copilot for VS Code plugin & Agentic Developer Toolkit. or Connect to Developer MCP server (For MCP configuration). Pair with fw-app-dev for manifest and validation fixes.
